On the IS&S card, it says it will burn any weapon with a cost more than 2
or damage more than 3?  Should those "more"s be "equal to or more"s?  It
seems to me that his is the only way those cards would be of any real use
would be if that were true.  According to Marier's list, the only weapon
that cost 3 or more would be the assault rifle and I have yet to see a weapon
that did 4 or more damage (though with a  cost of 5, the assault rifle but
just do it).

Submachine Guns do 4R and cost 4 pool (qualifying on both counts), and
Flamethrowers do 2R (agg) and also cost 4 pool.

So far, none of these 3 weapons have actually been fired in combat in our
group.  They either get IS&S'd or someone plays a "strike to destroy weapon"
card on them in their first combat.  They're just too scary to let live :)

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Geoffrey DeWan <gdewan@prairienet.org> wrote:
>On the IS&S card, it says it will burn any weapon with a cost more than 2
>or damage more than 3?  Should those "more"s be "equal to or more"s?...

IS&S will burn any weapon which meets one or both of the following terms:

1.  Costs more than 2 pool.
2.  Does more than 3 damage.

Weapons which qualify: RPG Launcher, Talbot's Chainsaw, Assault Rifle,
Bomb, Flame Thrower, Submachine Gun.
